job.title: Delete this job for good?
job.lead: “{{title}}” disappears from the app with everything about it:
job.notDiscard: Deleting is not discarding. Discarding closes it and keeps it in your history and in Results; deleting removes it from the app for good.
job.goes1: its history and stage, which stop counting in Results
job.goes2: the CVs, cover letters, answers and drafts made for it
job.goes3: its interviews, tests and deadlines in the calendar
job.goes4: the company's emails that were only about this application
job.stays: Files already in your data folder (CV PDFs, the copy of what you sent) are kept. If it arrives again in an alert, it comes in as new.
job.backup: A backup is saved first: it's the only way to get it back.
job.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the company name: {{company}}

all.title: Clear jobs and applications
all.intro: To start from scratch: deletes every job with its history, CVs, cover letters, interviews and emails.
all.step1Title: Clear all your jobs and applications?
all.step2Body: A backup of everything is saved first in your data folder: it's the only way to get it back. Files already there (CV PDFs, the copy of what you sent) are kept.
all.step1Body_one: {{count}} job and everything about it is deleted, including what Results and the calendar show. It can't be undone from the app.
all.step1Body_other: {{count}} jobs and everything about them are deleted, including what Results and the calendar show. It can't be undone from the app.
all.done_one: Done: {{count}} job deleted. Backup taken before: {{backup}}
all.done_other: Done: {{count}} jobs deleted. Backup taken before: {{backup}}
all.stays: Your profile, templates, sources, mailboxes, contacts network and settings stay.

duplicates.bannerText: They are the same opening as another job, with an almost identical title. They are no longer created, but the ones saved earlier remain under “Closed”.
duplicates.lead: Each one is removed with its history. The original stays and keeps their postings, so a new search recognises them without opening them.

keep.no_longer_duplicate: it is no longer closed as a duplicate
keep.own_work: it has its own work (CV, notes, application…)

duplicates.backup: A backup of the database is saved in the data folder first.
duplicates.done_one: {{count}} duplicate job deleted. Backup taken first: {{backup}}
duplicates.done_other: {{count}} duplicate jobs deleted. Backup taken first: {{backup}}
